message.content: For the Unity Catalog migration Impetus and Databricks asked us to grant Impetus account-level admin privileges and we complied after internal review with stakeholders. After yesterday's incident and detailed coordination with Databricks and Impetus we revoked that admin access promptly with clear audit notes to avoid similar accidents. To address metricism concerns Impetus will now use a separate workspace during operations under strict security guardrails continuously to limit disruption to active TLP workspaces. TLP's normal data pipeline operation remains the top priority for this Unity Catalog migration and we will stay vigilant every working day through all remaining steps.
